title: UI-UX-Programmer 5
description:
Job Responsibilities: 

The selected Consultant will be directly responsible for designing a modern intuitive UI/UX, and will have direct experience interacting with business users to create the UI/UX.


They will work closely with the designated Business Users, I.T. supervisor, project managers, and development staff within an agile development environment maintaining a user-centered design approach as you tackle complex design problems and influence product strategy.


Proactively identifying areas of the product that need improvement and driving those improvements into a product roadmap.


The Consultant, in working with ODPS staff, will be responsible for researching, designing, and developing user interface using Prototyping Designer tools. The new applications will implement an N-tier architecture and comply with ODPS coding standards.

During the interview process with the ODPS staff, the resource consultant must demonstrate competence/experience in their specific area(s) of project assignment. The resource consultant must also present or share their portfolio with samples. The resource’s experience must also be documented for review and verification. Offered resources not showing technical or functional competence/experience will be sufficient reason to reject the Offeror’s proposal. It is the responsibility of the Offeror to pre-screen their candidates to ensure compliance. Resource will have a background check conducted by ODPS.
1.Participate in meetings with stakeholders, business users, and engineering teams to understand and project UI requirements.
2.Design wireframes and interactive prototypes and user-friendly designs that support complex business processes.
3.Work on various stages of the product development process from discovery to research to design user interface.
4.Test and iterate various product concepts with users; conduct user research and analysis to validate the design.
5.Work with project managers, developers, and business analysts to brainstorm ideas, approaches, and design solutions.
6.Experience in creating ‘Design System’ Library for reusability.
7.Create a seamless UI handoff process to development team.
8.Ensure that user interface and experience designs follow best practices and comply with security requirements.
9.Integration with Backend: Work closely with backend developers to integrate front-end components.
10.Participate in backlog grooming sessions and other agile ceremonies to ensure Agile development teams have a good understanding of the proposed UI design to implement successfully.
11.Strong communication/ leadership skills.
12.Strong influence, collaboration, and negotiation experience.
13.Ability to collaborate with supporting resources across business and/or functional lines.
14.Ability to communicate ideas to a wide variety of stakeholders, lead discussions and creative activities, and build consensus while dealing with ambiguity.

15.Ability to lead and manage large design initiatives, including managing competing priorities with product and engineering peers.

16.Have excellent oral and written skills/possess strong meeting and work session facilitation skills.

17.Have the ability to work independently and as part of a team, the ability to manage time and resources to meet assigned deadlines.

18.Have strong understanding of prioritization stemming from the elicitation of system and/or user requirements.

19.Have excellent organizational skills, proven analytical, planning, problem solving, and decision-making skills.

20.Must be knowledgeable in the English language/speak clearly and understandably use the English language.

21.Provides technical guidance and mentoring to technical staff.

title: Trade Compliance Specialist - Imports
description:
Job Description
Assume responsibility for delivery and execution of a standardized, regional import compliance program to support the enterprise for the functional area of responsibility in coordination with the Sr. Manager – Imports Americas. Must have direct experience with Americas import compliance.
Responsibilities:
•             Supports the strategic development, delivery and execution of a standardized compliant trade compliance program to support the enterprise for the functional area of responsibility in coordination with the Sr. Manager Trade Compliance – Imports Americas.
•             Support the investigations, audits or disclosures regarding the company's import compliance activities in the Americas.
•             Based on audit findings, this role will assist with root cause analysis and supporting resolution of compliance issues as needed. 
•             Support trade compliance training for the Americas. To be prioritized in accordance with the Sr. Manager Trade Compliance – Imports Americas as needed.
•             Stay current in company international Trade Compliance regulations, policies, training, audit programs and Corporate Trade Compliance initiatives for the Americas.
•             Researches trade regulations and rulings, determines regulatory or interpretive basis for each classification, and communicates with internal clients and external service providers.
•             Provide guidance on multiple international Trade Compliance matters as needed.
•             Adheres to the company's international trade compliance policies in coordination with goals and objectives of the Sr. Manager Trade Compliance – Imports Americas.
•             Support the trade compliance related recordkeeping program and reconciliation, organization and maintenance on a regular basis for the appropriate functional area of responsibility as needed.
•             Responsible for daily interaction with compliance service providers to resolve compliance related inquiries and requests.
•             Monitor and manage daily trade compliance related international transaction holds, reviews and information needed without disruption while ensuring compliant transactions.
•             Responsible for identification of areas for process improvement in the daily resolution of trade compliance related international transaction holds and issues.
•             Supports projects as needed.
•             Assist with the development, implementation and keeping current standard operating procedures and work instructions to support functional area of responsibility as needed.
•             Stay abreast of all issues and regulations that impact trade compliance activities through trade publications, communications with service providers and regular reviews of the appropriate government websites and trade association memberships.
•             Liaison with internal departments across business units on regulatory and duty matter as needed.
•             Perform other duties associated with trade compliance as may be required maintaining a customer focused attitude and assisting the Sr. Manager Trade Compliance – Imports Americas.
 
Qualifications:
•             Bachelor’s degree
•             Direct experience in import compliance for the Americas.
•             5-7 Years of Industry Experience in International trade area
•             Subject matter expertise in relevant areas of trade compliance (import regulation, classification, valuation, export and import authorizations, import licensing, etc.) is required.
•             Fluency in English oral and written
•             US Customs Broker license preferred not required
•             Bilingual (English/Spanish) preferred not required
•             Up to 0-10% travel
 
Key Competencies:
•             Ensure Compliance with international trade regulations and internal policies
•             Cost optimization in customs and trade related expenses
•             Strive for continuous improvement and opportunities for trade automation
•             Maintain strong customer focus
•             Project management and strong computer skills preferred (emphasis on Microsoft Office programs, particularly Excel)
•             The ability to function both as a team and individual player with the ability to shift priorities as required by the Americas trade compliance team and business operations.
•             Support performance metrics and evaluate internal and external service providers.
•             Demonstrated skills in resolving business challenges
•             Analytical skills, be detailed oriented, and possesses the ability to anticipate problems and diffuse situations.
•             The ability to multitask and ability to work under time constraints and business priorities.
•             Working knowledge of Oracle and Trade Automation (E2Open) is preferred.

title: Facilities Maintenance Technician
description:
Job Description:
Top 3 skills
• • Hands-On Equipment Experience
The ideal candidate will have direct experience working with equipment — including repair, calibration, and installation. While our focus is on laboratory equipment, we value experience with electronic or mechanical systems of any kind. A strong troubleshooting mindset and familiarity with tools and diagnostics are essential.
• • Mechanical Aptitude Across Contexts
We’re looking for someone with strong mechanical aptitude who can adapt their skills to a variety of equipment and situations. Whether it’s understanding how a system works or figuring out how to fix it, this person should be comfortable diving into unfamiliar setups and applying sound mechanical reasoning.
• • Ownership & Accountability
As part of a small, agile team (you’ll be the fourth member), we need someone who takes full ownership of their work. You’ll be trusted to manage tasks independently, follow through on commitments, and proactively solve problems — without needing constant oversight. Reliability, initiative, and a sense of responsibility are key.

Position Summary
The Facilities Maintenance Technician II is responsible for performing a wide variety of maintenance activities in a clean manufacturing setting. Work will include inspections, calibrations, preventative maintenance, troubleshooting, and repairs of all systems within the company facilities. The position will perform work in one or more of the following maintenance trades; metrology, electrical, electronics, plumbing, high purity water systems, steam (boiler) systems.

Essential Functions
• Perform inspections, preventative maintenance, and repairs throughout the facilities, manufacturing areas, laboratories, and grounds.
o Perform preventative maintenance, troubleshooting, and repairs on building and manufacturing and Lab equipment.
o Initiate, complete, and close out work orders using the Computerized Maintenance Management System.
o Schedule and escort outside service providers
o Respond to emergencies, participating in the rotating on-call program.
• This position acts as a subject matter expert on one or more building component, or manufacturing equipment.
o Assist facilities department management on decisions involving areas of expertise.
o Assist in training of other department personnel in subject matter expertise.
• Follows all Standard Operating Procedures and assists with updating as needed.
• Maintain documentation in accordance with Department SOPs and ISO 13485 requirements.
• Perform other duties as assigned
• All employees are responsible for the general upkeep of work and shared spaces
• Punctual and regular attendance is required of all employees

Qualifications
Experience:
• 2-5+ years of maintenance experience in a commercial, manufacturing, or laboratory setting. Technical education can be substituted for experience.

Education
• High School Diploma required.
• Technical degree strongly preferred.

Skills & Knowledge
• Must have superior mechanical and troubleshooting skills.
• Good organizational and time management skills. Must be able to handle several tasks at once and be able to prioritize.
• Strong attention to detail.
• Computer and email use including MS Office applications.
• Must possess a valid driver’s license.
• Knowledge of Building Automations Systems a plus

Working Conditions
At times this position works in a Clinical and Research Grade lab setting and may come in contact with various solutions and chemicals. This position uses hand tools, power tools, and testing equipment. This position will require driving a vehicle and work indoors and outdoors.

Physical Requirements:
While performing the duties of this position, the employee is regularly required to see, talk and hear. The employee frequently is required to stand, walk, bend, lift up to 50 pounds, and use arms, hands and fingers for various activities. This position may stand or remain sedentary for long periods of time. This position routinely works with large pieces of equipment.

title: Manufacturing/Production Associate
description:
Job Description:
Top 3 Skills:
1. The ability to set up and operate machinery. Operation consists of monitoring the machine’s temperatures, pressures, flowrates, etc. via various gauges and then adjusting the appropriate part of the machine to ensure all those values are within the acceptable range for operation.
2. Follows engineering drawings, work order information, Manufacturing Assembly Procedures, SOPs, and other written and verbal specifications and requirements in the manufacturing process.
3. Knowledge of basic mathematics; ability to communicate, read, comprehend, and follow written work instructions in English; working knowledge of computers and Microsoft OS; and ability to use basic measuring equipment (rulers, calipers, etc...)

Job Description
• Sets up and operates automatic or semiautomatic machines and related equipment in a continuous production/processing operation.
• Monitors meters, gauges, valves, flow ratios, temperatures, pressures, and related controls and guidelines to ensure adherence to production/process specifications.
• Contribute to improving manufacturing processes through solution-based ideation for continuous improvements
• Escalate any manufacturing process issues in a timely manner to minimize scrap and downtime
• Complete appropriate documentation to ensure compliance with policies and procedures – including but not limited to production documents, batch control records, scrap/quality issues, and scorecards.

Education/Experience
• HS Diploma or GED required.
• Minimum 2 years of Manufacturing Experience
• Knowledge of basic mathematics; ability to read, comprehend, and follow written work instructions in English; working knowledge of computers and Microsoft OS; and ability to use basic measuring equipment (rulers, calipers, etc...)
• Must be able to lift up to 30 lbs repetitively
• Must be able to work overtime as required
• Ability to safely work with certain solvents, e.g. IPA, DMAC and other common, as required
